title: A social post, approved, goes live with its link
description: Publishing is a gated action. The agent attempts the post with the exact text, the person approves the card, and the reply returns the post's link.

turns.text: Post this on our LinkedIn page now, exactly as written: "Cold brew restock is live. Batch {nonce} ships this week."

responder.default_reply: Yes, post it to LinkedIn exactly as written.

match.arguments.post_snapshot.content: ^Cold brew restock is live\. Batch {nonce} ships this week\.$

checks.why: The LinkedIn post the person approved did not go out now, or went out more than once.
A second post, or a post somewhere else, was put in front of the person.
After publishing, the person was not given the post's link.

criteria.check: The post is the text the person gave, unchanged.
